HF: source product information explicitly references pure hydrogen fluoride, CAS 7664-39-3. Native name, formula HF, fluorspar/sulphuric-acid route and positive kg reference identify hydrogen fluoride, but its stated CAS 73602-61-6 conflicts with those facts and is associated with a triethylamine fluoride reagent.
